brief: Prioritize Jessup Water 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-442) for pre-event attention because its advanced age of 35 years and history of high loading reduce its margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure (MG-023). Because this asset has ONAN cooling, the forced cooling recovery instructions in MG-025 do not apply. Where this unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
